details: The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive educational platform designed to help children experience virtual astronaut training and explore space. It includes activities such as planet exploration, gravity challenges, spacewalk simulations, and space survival training. Users can complete exciting missions, learn about the solar system, and develop problem-solving skills. The project aims to make space education fun, engaging, and accessible while inspiring young minds to pursue STEM and space science. NASA's open-source resources, space images, and publicly available datasets can support the learning experience. Our vision is to inspire the next generation of astronauts and space explorers.
